whoTheyAre.summary: The current PeopleGroups.org record identifies Anii in Benin and ties the record to Anii (blo). Independent linguistic sources place Anii in Benin and Togo, while recent fieldwork in Bassila documents active language research and community literacy work.

religionAndCommunity.summary: PeopleGroups.org supplies an aggregate primary-religion label for this people-group-in-country record. The label is useful source context but is not a claim about the beliefs or practice of every Anii person.

claims.text: The current PeopleGroups.org profile PG012305 identifies the people-group record as Anii in Benin and lists Anii (blo) as its primary language.
Glottolog identifies Anii with glottocode anii1245 and ISO 639-3 code blo, and lists Benin and Togo among its countries.

A 2009 SIL sociolinguistic survey of Anii-Akpe communities in Benin and Togo reported strong intercomprehension evidence, no indication of language shift at the time, and positive attitudes toward Anii language development.
claims.interpretationNote: These are historical survey findings and are not presented as a measurement of current language use in every Anii community.

claims.text: Recent linguistic fieldwork in Bassila, Benin describes collaborative work with Anii speakers and a local team that publishes Anii material and promotes literacy, complementing earlier survey evidence of community interest in language development.
claims.interpretationNote: The Cambridge work focuses on the Bassila dialect and should not be generalized to every Anii-speaking locality.

claims.text: The current PeopleGroups.org Anii of Benin profile reports Folk Islam as its aggregate primary-religion label.
claims.interpretationNote: This is a provider classification for PG012305, not a statement about each Anii person’s belief or practice.

claims.text: PeopleGroups.org currently reports GSEC 1 and less than 2% evangelical for PG012305 and presents the record as Engaged yet Unreached.
claims.interpretationNote: These are source-native mission-research fields for one people-group-in-country record, not a judgment about individuals.

claims.text: The current PeopleGroups.org profile reports no film entries for Anii (blo) on its media-resource surface while separately linking Anii Bible-resource providers.
claims.interpretationNote: Provider resource links do not by themselves establish distribution, comprehension, use or translation completeness in Anii communities.
